name: Mindweave Synthetic Hotel PMS Dataset
what_it_holds: Synthetic, relationally-consistent PMS dataset generated by Mindweave Technologies: 4 tables (guests, properties, rooms, reservations). Free sample 2,180 rows; full dataset 21,808 rows (8,000 guests, 3 properties, 177 rooms, 13,628 reservations) sold via Gumroad, CC-BY-NC-4.0. Includes seasonal pricing that fluctuates with demand, lead time and cancellation patterns with 'realistic' distributions, and injected anomalies (a March conference booking surge, a November facility closure). Available as CSV/Parquet/SQLite. Not on GitHub; no linked source repo.
why_useful: A structurally realistic multi-table PMS schema (guests/rooms/properties/reservations) that could serve as a template for what a real STR/hotel PMS export looks like, useful mainly as a methods reference rather than as ABNB-relevant real data; low direct value since it is synthetic and partly paywalled.

name: dvrpc/economic-subsectors
what_it_holds: Analyzes 3-digit NAICS subsectors (industries incl. accommodation) at the county/regional level using County Business Patterns (CBP), Quarterly Census of Employment and Wages (QCEW), and Current Population Survey (CPS) data for the Delaware Valley (Philadelphia) region; committed processing code plus regional extracts.
why_useful: A worked example of joining CBP + QCEW for a NAICS subsector, showing how to build a regional hotel-establishment/employment series; useful as a code template even though the region (Philadelphia metro) is narrow.
time_coverage: Not specified in listing, recent CBP/QCEW vintages
themes: Hotel supply data: Overture/OSM hotel POI counts, hotel pipeline datasets, lodging census (Census QSS NAICS 721), county business patterns tooling
